partners.mechanism_chain: ASAH1 (HGNC:1065) —DISRUPTS→ Sphingomyelin (CHEBI:26891); Sphingomyelin (CHEBI:26891) —LEADS_TO→ Spinal muscular atrophy-progressive myoclonic epilepsy syndrome (MONDO:0008045); HBB (HGNC:4827) —DISRUPTS→ Hemoglobin (GO:0005344); Hemoglobin (GO:0005344) —LEADS_TO→ Beta-thalassemia (MONDO:0013517). Mutations in ASAH1 lead to a loss of function, resulting in impaired sphingomyelin metabolism and contributing to spinal muscular atrophy-progressive myoclonic epilepsy syndrome. Similarly, mutations in HBB lead to a loss of function, impairing hemoglobin production and causing beta-thalassemia. The convergence occurs at the level of functional impairment of critical protein production, leading to distinct but severe phenotypes.
